Investing in India from a country sharing a land border? Understand Press Note 3 first.  
  
India's Press Note 3 (PN3) regulates foreign investment involving countries that share a land border with India. The 2026 changes have eased certain restrictions, but they have not removed the compliance requirements altogether.

results.title: Enabling U.S. Foreign Investment in South Asia | Asia Society
results.snippet: The divergence in U.S. investments in India compared to its neighbors points to differences in the conditions that enable foreign investment. There are three enabling factors for foreign investment in which India has made greater progress relative to its regional peers: economic formalization and digitization, capital-market depth and accessibility, and diaspora networks.
